assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide website hero photograph, landscape 3:2. Create an exceptional editorial architectural photograph of a Northern California courtyard garden: a low monolithic rammed-earth wall on the right, sculptural multi-stem olive tree off center right, a shallow reflective pool, large weathered limestone stepping slabs leading from foreground into lush native grasses and ferns. Dawn haze and long low sunlight, deep shadowed forest greens, beautifully irregular foliage, tactile stone. Shot on medium format for a landscape architecture magazine. Composition fills the whole image with a real garden, no sky at top left, generous dark leafy area in upper left for white overlay heading, panoramic depth, no people. Understated, cinematic and natural, not a render. No text, no logo, no collage, no borders.

No props, no words, no logo, no watermark.
